title: fix(rest)!: the batch door judges each op's API exposure on the object the data door serves (#27899)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLpW5ZoNUB4CBh4NAaW3pD3)_
Fixes #27899

domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwgfUuNAvcUg3JzBiR

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no hand-written docs page or published skill states what the cross-object batch door answers about an object's API exposure, or how a short name resolves there (`git grep` of `content/docs` outside `references/`/`releases/` and of `skills/` for `apiEnabled`, `apiMethods` or `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` beside the batch door: 0 hits; `http-protocol.mdx` names the door only as the `transactionalBatch` capability).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:跨对象批量接口 `POST /batch` 的逐操作 API 暴露闸,改用 `/data/OBJ` 暴露闸的同一个按名读法(从 `enforceApiAccess` 抽成 `RestServer` 的一个私有方法,两处共用)。每个操作判的,就是数据门按这个名字会服务的那个对象;拒绝时回的状态码与正文和数据门一字不差。
- 为什么改:按分诊 6514615922,这是 #27728 / #27729 一族的最后一扇门。原先它按声明名在对象清单里找对象,清单不做旧式 `ns__short` 短名解析,于是这类对象用短名时被当成未知对象放行,答案与 `/data` 门不一致(实测,见 Tests)。
- 风险与回滚:收窄,changeset 已写 BREAKING 说明与 ADR-0087 处置;只影响用短名指向带 `__` 的旧对象、且该对象限制了 API 暴露的批量操作,已发运的对象都不带 `__`。读法由每请求一次清单读变为每个不同对象一次按名读。回滚即还原 `batch-routes.ts` 的闸块与 `rest-server.ts` 的私有读法两处。
- 先看:`packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts`(逐操作闸块);`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` 的 `loadObjectItem`(从 `enforceApiAccess` 抽出,并接到批量路由的 host 上);新测试 `packages/rest/src/batch-op-exposure-object-read.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/batch-op-exposure-object-read.test.ts`,预期 9/9 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(契约复审由席位安排)。

## What changes

- **One read for every data door's exposure gate.** The read the `/data/:object` gate (`enforceApiAccess`) made inline — `loadObjectItem` in `meta-item-read-gate.ts`, over the protocol's by-name execution read, or its list read for a protocol with no by-name read — is now one private method, `RestServer#loadObjectItem(p, environmentId, name)`. `enforceApiAccess` calls it for the route's `:object`, and the cross-object batch route calls it for each op's object through `BatchRouteHost`.
- **The batch door's per-op gate.** It used to read the whole object list once and look each op up by the item's declared name. The by-name read resolves a legacy `ns__short` object from its short name as the data door's `registry.getObject` does; the list does not. The gate now judges the object the data door serves for the op's name, so such an op is refused with the data door's answer, status and body (`apiAccessDenialFromEnable`, unchanged), before the transaction opens. Each distinct object is read once per request; each distinct (object, action) is judged once, in op order; the first refusal answers for the whole batch, as before.
- **The private list read retired.** `RestServer#loadObjectItems` had this gate as its only caller, so it is gone, and `BatchRouteHost` carries `loadObjectItem` in its place. The two #3545 observability pins in `rest.test.ts` that called it by name now call the method that replaced it, with the same assertions (fail open, a thrown read logged, an empty registry silent). Docblocks that named the batch as a reader of the object list now say otherwise (`meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `metaListSource`, one line of `objectql-slot-consumer-census.test.ts`).

## Why

Triage 6514615922: the `/batch` per-op gate reads each op's object through the same read as the `/data` gate and refuses the same way. PR #27897 gave the `/data` gate this read; the batch door was the last data door that answered differently about whether an object is exposed.

## Tests

New `packages/rest/src/batch-op-exposure-object-read.test.ts`: a real `ObjectQL` engine, the real protocol and the real `RestServer` routes on a sqlite `:memory:` driver, with `objectQLProvider` wired so the batch door is reachable, and the metadata store registered (without it both object reads answer `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and every exposure gate fails open by design, #3545). Fixtures: legacy-named objects of one package (one unexposed, one exposed for reads only, one exposed), addressed by their short names, and one plain-named unexposed object.

- **Refusal pins (red before, green after).** A create, update or delete op on the unexposed object: status and body equal the `/data/:object` answer for the same name, the transaction never opens, no row. A write the object does not expose in bulk: status and body equal `POST /data/:object/createMany`'s 405. One refused op refuses the whole batch: an exposed op ahead of it is not written.
- **Controls (green before and after).** Premise: the data door resolves the short name and refuses the unexposed object. The full name is refused, as it already was. An exposed object is written under its short name and its full name in one batch. A plain-named unexposed object is refused, as it already was.

Before and after, through the real `POST /batch` door (base `d4064cc1` with only the test committed, then head `2019e190`):

| op | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| create, unexposed object | 200, row written | 404 `OBJECT_API_DISABLED`, equal to `/data` |
| update / delete, unexposed object | 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` (passed the gate, reached the engine) | 404 `OBJECT_API_DISABLED`, equal to `/data` |
| write the object does not expose in bulk | 200, row written | 405 `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, equal to `createMany` |
| exposed op, then an unexposed op | 200, both written | 404, nothing written |
| the four controls | as listed above | unchanged |

<details><summary>Red first, ablation, package suite</summary>

- Red first, `ec6f33ef`..`db7513a4` (test only, on the base code): `Tests 5 failed | 4 passed (9)`, the five refusal pins red and the four controls green.
- Fix, `2019e190`: `Tests 9 passed (9)`; with `rest-batch-endpoint`, `rest`, `import-door-object-existence`, `objectql-slot-consumer-census`, `rest-batch-blank-id`: `Test Files 6 passed (6) · Tests 294 passed (294)`.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit once, blob `0ce906d7` to `23cf0acd`): the gate counted the read item only under the op's declared name, the old list semantics. `Tests 5 failed | 4 passed (9)`, the same five red. Restored: blob equals HEAD `0ce906d7`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: `Test Files 351 passed (351) · Tests 6775 passed | 332 skipped (7107)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Read cost.** The batch gate made one object-list read per request; it now makes one by-name read per distinct object of the batch, on the protocol's execution face, which decorates nothing. A batch names few distinct objects, and the batch size cap still bounds it.
- **Fail-open logging.** A thrown object read still fails open and logs (#3545), measured unchanged in kind: without the metadata store, the list read and the by-name read both answer `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, so the gate's verdict in an outage is the same as before. The log is now one line per distinct object rather than one per request.
- **Disabled package.** An object of a disabled package reads as no object here, as the list omitted it, and the op is refused inside the transaction by the data plane, as before (`loadObjectItem`'s `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` branch; read from the code, not measured here).
- `objectql-slot-consumer-census.test.ts` keeps its measured sentence about where a real op goes on the multi-kernel harness; only the method name changed, the sentence was not re-measured.
- `origin/main` moved after the branch point (`d4064cc1`..`ed0e71db`); its `packages/rest` changes touch other files, and `git merge-tree` against it is clean, so the branch was not merged.

## Verification

Head `2019e190`, base `d4064cc1`, after a whole-tree build (`turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

<details><summary>Derived gate families and lint</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 61 families over the 7 changed paths. All 61 exited 0, and `pnpm lint` exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`; `pnpm lint` recorded outside the derivation. `check-adr-0087-registration`: `1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition.`

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood battery (narrowing arm), head 2019e190</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, no shard: `Test Files 357 passed | 3 skipped (360) · Tests 2875 passed | 20 skipped (2895)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.

- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
